_comment: Username enumeration provider endpoints and configurable numeric suffix interpretations. Suffixes are hints only, never recorded as DOB or identity evidence. Date candidates are calendar-validated.

platforms._comment: Only curated detection methods; challenge and rate-limited responses remain unknown.

patterns._comment: Validation and trailing digit extraction expressions; all suffix heuristics use these patterns.

numeric_suffix._comment: Century windows and plausible four-digit year range are configurable interpretation thresholds, not assertions of age.

network._comment: Default CLI network timeout and parallel worker count for public profile lookups.

telegram_markers._comment: Public Telegram account markers; templates may change and positive detection remains a hypothesis.
